correctness.rationale: Every prescribed three-arrow completion has Ewens weight theta^closed_cycles times the (n-3)-point rising factorial. Marked closed cycles reduce each coefficient to a degree-at-most-three polynomial in the before/after-window counts. Ten triangular lattice points uniquely determine those polynomials. Exact coefficient enumeration at all ten points verifies the six formulas for all n, not by unsupported extrapolation; independent weighted permutation tests reinforce this. Positivity of denominator, boundary n=3 and theta>0 included.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural minimal higher-order local dependence classification under a canonical conjugacy-invariant random permutation law. All single adjacent inversion marginals are position-homogeneous, yet four triple laws have precise nonzero affine positional gradients, with a sharp reversal at theta=1. That distinction is structural and not a mere parameter substitution or isolated calculation.
